title: Patents for a memory-erasing 'neuralizer' technology

tellings.quote: Well, I kind of learned some stuff on that and I saw the patents on it.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says UFOs come to him and that NASA studies him, says he has seen US patents for technology that can wipe memories, like the "neuralizer" gadget from the Men in Black films. He tells it first hand, saying he "learned some stuff on that," as a hint that such memory-erasing tools are real.
